title: Lyciscus
summary: Raleigh names Lyciscus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Lyciscus, whose Daughter the lot named for that sacrifice. He fled with her into Sparta. Her name is not printed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. IV, sig. 365a–365b
